book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The next day, Fogg stayed in his room.
And in the evening, he asked to see Aouda.
And sat before her, and said: madam.
When I brought you to England, I was rich.

sentences.ar: وكنت رح أعطيك مصاري تعيشي فيها.
sentences.en: And I was going to give you money to live on.
Fogg said: I did not lose for you.

sentences.ar: قالت عودا: وشو رح تعمل هلق؟
sentences.en: Aouda said: and what will you do now?
Fogg said: I do not know.
And Aouda held out her hand.

sentences.ar: بدك مرا تكون معك، بالغنى وبالفقر؟
sentences.en: Do you want a wife to be with you, in wealth and in poverty?
And for the first time, something moved in his face.
And Passepartout, behind the door, danced.
And Passepartout ran to the priest.

sentences.ar: ورجع بعد عشر دقايق، بيركض، وبيصرخ.
sentences.en: And came back ten minutes later, running, and shouting.
Passepartout said: because tomorrow is Sunday!

sentences.ar: قال باسبارتو: لا! اليوم السبت! 21 ديسمبر!
sentences.en: Passepartout said: no! Today is Saturday! 21 December!
And Fogg stood, and understood in an instant.

sentences.ar: لأنه سافر شرق، مع الشمس، ربح يوم.
sentences.en: Because he had travelled east, with the sun, he had gained a day.

sentences.ar: تمانين يوم عنده، تسعة وسبعين بلندن.
sentences.en: Eighty days for him, seventy-nine in London.
And he had half an hour.

sentences.ar: وبنادي ريفورم، الخمسة قاعدين، والساعة بتدق.
sentences.en: And at the Reform Club, the five sat, the clock ticking.
The bank director said: it is over.
And the engineer said: twenty seconds.

sentences.ar: وفيلياس فوغ دخل، وقال: أنا هون يا سادة.
sentences.en: And Phileas Fogg came in, and said: here I am, gentlemen.

sentences.ar: ربح عشرين ألف، وصرف تسعتعشر بالطريق.
sentences.en: He won twenty thousand, and had spent nineteen on the road.

sentences.ar: وباقي الألف، قسمه بين باسبارتو وفيكس.
sentences.en: And the remaining thousand, he divided between Passepartout and Fix.
And Passepartout paid for the gas.

sentences.ar: وفوغ، اللي لف حول الدنيا عشان عشرين ألف، ربح شي تاني.
sentences.en: And Fogg, who had gone round the world for twenty thousand, had won something else.
A lovely woman, who loved him.

sentences.ar: ومين ما بيلف حول الدنيا عشان أقل من هيك؟
sentences.en: And who would not go round the world for less?
